guide: NDOT Interstate 80 Rest Areas guide (Oct. 2015) for open public sites; NDOT Nov. 5, 2026 USDOT-grants release for the planned Dawson County project.
note: Truck-space counts come from NDOT's October 2015 rest-area guide. Lots may have been re-striped since; same-day availability must be checked on Nebraska 511. Private truck stops are not inventoried here.

sites.name: Sidney Rest Area Eastbound
sites.notes: Largest truck count of any I-80 rest area in the guide; additional truck parking noted. Observation area and Golden Link I-80 completion marker. 4 mi west of the West Sidney interchange.

sites.name: Sidney Rest Area Westbound
sites.notes: Picnic shelters and play area. 2 mi east of the East Sidney interchange.

sites.name: Deuel County Interchange 101 Truck Lot
sites.notes: Surfaced 8-acre lot at the US-138 interchange with I-80; no amenities. Access from US-138. Nearest corridor hub is Ogallala, about 25 mi east; Sidney is about 40 mi west.

sites.name: Ogallala Rest Area Eastbound
sites.notes: Picnic tables, play area, summer tourist information. 3 mi west of Ogallala.

sites.name: Ogallala Rest Area Westbound
sites.notes: Picnic tables, play area, summer tourist information. 4 mi east of Ogallala.

sites.name: Sutherland Rest Area Eastbound
sites.notes: Oregon Trail / O'Fallons Bluff historic site; trail still visible. 2 mi east of Sutherland.

sites.name: Sutherland Rest Area Westbound
sites.notes: Picnic tables, play area, summer tourist information. 3 mi east of Sutherland.

sites.name: Brady Rest Area Westbound
sites.notes: Pull-thru truck parking; small fishing lake. 4 mi west of the Brady interchange.

sites.name: Brady Rest Area Eastbound
sites.notes: Pull-thru truck parking plus 13 RV/trailer spaces. 4 mi west of the Brady interchange.

sites.name: Cozad Rest Area Eastbound
sites.notes: Serves the Cozad/Gothenburg stretch; nearest hub is Lexington. 5 mi east of Cozad.

sites.name: Cozad Rest Area Westbound
sites.notes: Serves the Cozad/Gothenburg stretch; nearest hub is Lexington. 5 mi east of Cozad.

sites.name: Dawson County Truck Parking (planned)
sites.notes: PLANNED — $7.46M INFRA Track 2 grant selected Nov. 5, 2026; $15.5M total project. Release says ~120 new stalls in one paragraph and ~92 in the director's quote. Sited between Elm Creek (Exit 257) and Overton (Exit 248); exact mileposts, exits and side of highway not announced. Not open; no construction dates.

sites.name: Kearney Rest Area Eastbound
sites.notes: Small fishing lake; family restroom; summer tourist information. 3 mi west of Kearney.

sites.name: Kearney Rest Area Westbound
sites.notes: Small fishing lake; family restroom; summer tourist information. 2 mi west of Kearney.

sites.name: Grand Island Rest Area Eastbound
sites.notes: Small fishing lake; family restroom; summer tourist information. 4 mi west of the Phillips interchange.

sites.name: Grand Island Rest Area Westbound
sites.notes: Family restroom; summer tourist information. 3 mi west of the Phillips interchange.

sites.name: York Rest Area Eastbound
sites.notes: Play area; family restroom; summer tourist information. 3 mi west of the York interchange.

sites.name: York Rest Area Westbound
sites.notes: Play area; family restroom; summer tourist information. 3 mi east of the York interchange.

sites.name: Goehner Westbound Truck Parking
sites.notes: TRUCK PARKING ONLY, listed as open with all services. The 2015 guide states no stall count, so no number is shown here. 2 mi east of the Goehner interchange.

sites.name: Blue River Rest Area Eastbound
sites.notes: Play area; family restroom. 1 mi west of the Milford interchange.

sites.name: Platte River Rest Area Eastbound
sites.notes: Pull-thru truck parking; play area; summer tourist information. About 4.2 mi east of the Greenwood interchange.

sites.name: Melia Hill Rest Area Westbound
sites.notes: Pull-thru truck parking plus 5 RV/trailer spaces; 9 picnic shelters; summer tourist information. Described as 2 miles west of the Highway 31 interchange (Exit 432).
